BiblicalUsage: leqesh means the after crop. In Amos 7:1, "he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the latter growth is God's timing in a vision — the grasshoppers formed just as the king's mowings were done, and Amos saw judgment coming.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
